title: Slow
description: Whenever you play a card, this enemy receives [blue]10%[/blue] more damage from Attacks this turn.
smart_description: This enemy receives [blue]10%[/blue] more damage from Attacks this turn. (Displays accumulated bonus per card played)
notes: Counter-type power that accumulates with each card the player plays. Each stack adds 10% multiplicative damage bonus to Attacks against the power's owner. Resets to 0 at the start of the enemy's turn.
